# NoteLink 0.3.0

[965b426] style: format Kotlin code and fix lint issues
    
    - Adjust line wrapping, indentation, and trailing commas
    - Declare network state permission and annotate the Bluetooth callback
    - Use KTX edit for SharedPreferences updates
    - Remove a redundant Android version check

[872bf11] feat(app): warm NoteLink v4 sessions and multi-NoteLink insert
    
    NoteLinkConnections keeps one session per paired NoteLink, racing LAN
    against BLE. Insert waits until every paired NoteLink has reported its
    counts, so the chooser appears when several have content. The chooser
    and settings show the control mode after the name.

[0e05388] feat(phone-desktop): NoteLink v4 host with LAN-only mode
    
    The desktop answers v4 over BLE when available and always over LAN
    (UDP 39818 discovery, TCP 39817 control), so a PC without Bluetooth can
    pair and transfer. Orphaned queue items are re-targeted to the paired
    Note on start and after pairing. The firewall script opens UDP 39818.

[3125184] feat(phone-app): NoteLink v4 host with code-entry pairing
    
    PhoneCommandProcessor implements NoteLinkHost (queue, export inbox, APK
    update, P2P). Pairing asks for the code shown on the Note. Items queued
    for a Note that is no longer paired are adopted on the next pairing.

[de5d3b1] feat(transfer-windows): per-client GATT events and multi-adapter LAN info
    
    nl_ble_poll_event/nl_ble_notify bridge per-subscriber records, MTU and
    connect events to Kotlin. nl_lan_info returns every Wi-Fi and Ethernet
    IPv4 address. Globals are guarded by the mutex.

[23d4f3c] feat(transfer-android): serialized GATT client and v4 BLE peripheral
    
    BleProtocolClient waits for every GATT callback (connect, MTU, discovery,
    CCCD, writes). The peripheral uses an AdvertisingSet updated in place and
    a pairing flag. Wi-Fi Direct joins with known credentials directly, and
    the network provider reports Wi-Fi/Ethernet LAN addresses.

[feac6dc] feat(transfer-core): NoteLink v4 protocol over BLE and LAN
    
    Protobuf v4 schema with SRP-6a pairing, a one-RTT PSK handshake and
    per-link ciphers. PeerConnection multiplexes exchanges over BLE, LAN
    and P2P links with keepalive. NoteLinkServer/NoteLinkClient implement
    fetch, lease, export push and APK update; LAN control works without
    Bluetooth through UDP discovery (39818) plus TCP (39817). The v3 BLE
    queue protocol is removed.

[20c30b9] build: add the protobuf plugin and a buf lint job for the v4 schema

[80ed442] docs: document the toolbar catalog, e-ink layer and export changes
    
    - Record the toolbar/UI architecture rules: catalog registration, scoped
      EinkTheme and ToolbarEffect handling.
    - Update the export section for fast raster mode, shared page cache keys, run
      reports, progress reporting and the v9 schema.

[f03670a] feat(ui): apply the e-ink theme to page, notebook and backup surfaces
    
    - Use the shared tokens and components in the hardware binding panel, notebook
      manager, page manager, page selection grid, notebook name dialog and backup
      screen.
    - Replace the remaining Material defaults (light grey selection, rounded
      buttons, RadioButton) with the 1 dp black-bordered e-ink chrome.

[d7e745e] feat(toolbar): drive the toolbar from a command catalog
    
    - Replace CommandRegistry.toolbar and MainActivity's per-tool when branches
      with ToolbarCatalog, ToolbarTool and pure ToolbarEffect values.
    - Dispatch commands through ToolbarCommandRouter and apply the effects in the
      app root through ToolEffectSink.
    - Derive the settings toolbar-visibility list, command titles and K1-K8
      bindings from the catalog instead of a parallel list.
    - Move ToolKind and EraserMode into EditorModes, keep item labels in the tool
      model and drop the ToolbarItem label/localizedLabel duplication.
    - Restyle the settings page and its toolbar list on the shared e-ink
      components, and add unit and instrumented coverage for the catalog, the
      effects and the settings chrome.

[8878c53] fix(backup): drop stale export reports when restoring
    
    Restored documents no longer correspond to the run reports left by the
    previous database, so delete files/exports/reports together with the other
    export caches.

[ad77353] feat(export): add fast raster pages, run reports and progress
    
    - Add ExportRenderMode with an opt-in fast mode that rasterizes each page once
      at 2x under an 8 MP / 8192 px cap and embeds it as one image.
    - Share page files between tasks through ExportPageCacheKey and publish a
      single-page PDF task's page file directly instead of merging.
    - Write a structured run report per task (mode, cache hits, stage timings,
      bytes, result) and surface it in the task info dialog.
    - Report elapsed time, ETA and throttled page progress through
      ExportProgressSink, and keep "cancelling" visible while a native PDF save
      blocks.
    - Composite PNG output from the MuPDF background plus ink, and keep one
      editable ink annotation per stroke in vector mode.
    - Add JVM and instrumented coverage for cache keys, raster limits, reports,
      fast pages, cancellation and cross-task cache reuse.

[e565ba2] feat(storage): add the v9 export render mode column
    
    - Bump the schema to v9 and add export_tasks.render_mode, defaulting to the
      editable vector ink of older tasks.
    - Migrate v8 databases in place and create the column for new databases.
    - Keep the v7 backup staging test on MigrationManager.VERSION and simulate a
      task table that predates the column.

[b6aedba] feat(ui): add the shared e-ink design system
    
    - Define the monochrome colours, hairline borders, 44 dp touch targets and
      typography roles in EinkTokens.
    - Add EinkTheme plus the shared toolbar, panel and progress components built
      from those tokens.
    - Move the modal overlay and its actions onto the same tokens, with an
      adjustable border width for dialogs that need emphasis.
    - Cover the token contract with JVM tests.

# NoteLink 0.2.6

[9f54a86] build: disable dependency and AGP version lint checks
    
    Lint's GradleDependency and AndroidGradlePluginVersion checks report available updates as errors, which fails the release quality gate even though dependency and AGP upgrades are handled explicitly. Keep all other lint checks as errors.

[12214e3] chore: ignore local Gradle home and DSH state
    
    Keep machine-local build caches and MCP configuration out of the repository.

[a93f304] docs: document tablet editing, backup and NoteLink deployment
    
    - Describe tail eraser, page management, hardware bindings and backup.
    - Document NoteLink share intake, send history, ordering, single-instance and Windows firewall behavior.

[054b2fe] feat(tablet): add app commands, tail eraser, backup and hardware bindings
    
    - Introduce a command registry and hardware shortcut bindings.
    - Support tail eraser selection and clipboard insertion.
    - Add notebook backup archives, restore UI and backup tests.
    - Refresh the editor, page manager, toolbar and settings surfaces.

[5d5e5fe] feat(notelink): add share intake, history, firewall and stable BLE pairing
    
    - Sniff and import supported shared files individually on Android.
    - Keep send history with payload retention on Android and Windows.
    - Add queue/stack ordering, Windows single-instance handoff and firewall diagnostics.
    - Keep BLE advertising stable across service restarts and allow authenticated LAN when the SSID is unknown.
    - Make the desktop dashboard scroll as a single page.

[a5fc8d8] feat(transfer-core): add content sniffing, send history and queue ordering
    
    - Sniff shared content by magic bytes, extension and declared MIME.
    - Persist send history with retention and crash reconciliation.
    - Apply queue/stack send order through QueueStore.next.
    - Allow authenticated LAN when the SSID fingerprint is unknown.

[d04cf36] chore: refine project description in README.md

[ab57d0e] chore: remove erroneously committed diagnostic information

[48a1358] fix(ci): remove references to deleted script tests
    
    Stop invoking the removed release-tag and full-changelog test scripts from CI and release preparation so both workflows can proceed to their maintained validation and build steps.

[cecd083] ci(release): publish a generated full changelog
    
    Build FULL_CHANGELOG.md from published product tags while preserving commit subjects and bodies, excluding sign-off trailers and prior generated changelog commits.
    
    Regenerate and push the document after releases, expose it through the repository ignore rules, and seed the tracked changelog from the existing BetterHvNote and NoteLink releases.

[8b3074b] feat(phone): import shared images and PDFs
    
    Accept single and multiple image or PDF shares, classify each stream from its provider MIME type with an intent fallback, and enqueue the matching transfer item.
    
    Keep text payload support and add unit plus instrumented coverage for external share and export actions.

[97e0d12] feat(export): queue jobs with diagnostics and retry controls
    
    Run export generation through a cancellable queue, report stage-specific progress and outcomes, retain detailed failure diagnostics, and expose explicit generate, retry, and cancel actions.
    
    Discover NoteLink clients at send time with permission handling, serialize the latest notebook state before export, and add JVM plus device workflow coverage.

[06d2358] feat(editor): streamline insertion and in-app feedback
    
    Route image and text insertion through one automatic source decision, preserve explicit local and NoteLink choices, and cover permission-aware entry behavior.
    
    Replace snackbars and the dedicated update banner with reusable e-ink notifications. Validate new-notebook canvas and template compatibility before creation and surface creation failures.

[a1e6e42] feat(ink): align strokes with ROM width geometry
    
    Treat the vendor callback scalar as a normalized stroke-width ratio, keep pen configuration stable for each gesture, and use transactional stroke modeling with whole-stroke raw fallback.
    
    Render the same swept-disc geometry in the editor, thumbnails, eraser hit testing, and PDF exports. Add pressure diagnostics, parity artifacts, and regression coverage for modeling, persistence, and geometry.
